info.title: Skwirrel PIM API
info.description:
Skwirrel PIM API, version 3. JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTPS.

- Every call is `POST https://{customer}.skwirrel.eu/jsonrpc` (production) or `https://{customer}.skwirrel.dev/jsonrpc` (dev/test). The method name goes in the request body.
- Send the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Version: 3`. Without it, core answers with the latest version.
- Authenticate with a static token in the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Token` (default), or with OAuth2 client credentials: `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id` and `client_secret`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Access tokens are valid for one hour.
- A Skwirrel administrator grants access per method. Without a grant, or with a wrong token, the call returns a JSON-RPC error.

params.name: etim_class_type

params.description: ETIM release (e.g. "ETIM-9.0"). Use "DYNAMIC" for MODELLING type only

params.name: price_base
params.description: Quantity base for which the price applies

params.name: price_base_uom
params.description: Unit of measurement for the price base

params.name: price_on_request
params.description: True if the price is available on request only

params.name: expires_in_days
params.description: Number of days until this price expires (0-65535)

methods.name: saveTradeItemTranslation
methods.description: Save or propose translated text for an existing trade item; does not change translation inheritance

params.name: add_to_changes
params.description: Queue an update for review instead of publishing

params.name: trade_item_id
params.description: Internal ID of the existing trade item

params.name: language
params.description: BCP 47 language code (e.g. nl, nl-BE)

params.name: context_id
params.description: Channel context ID; defaults to 1

examples.name: Propose Dutch trade item text
examples.description: Without add_to_changes, a publishing client receives outcome=applied and change_request_id=null. A no-op proposal returns outcome=no_changes and change_request_id=null.

methods.name: saveTradeItemVat
methods.description: Set the VAT rate code for a trade item in a specific country

params.name: trade_item_id
params.description: Internal ID of the trade item

params.name: country_code
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

params.name: vat_code
params.description: VAT or tax code applicable in the specified country

methods.name: saveWebHook
methods.description: Create or update a webhook subscription for entity change notifications

params.name: web_hook_id
params.description: Internal ID of the webhook; omit to create a new webhook

params.name: external_web_hook_id
params.description: Your system's reference ID for the webhook

params.name: web_hook_url
params.description: HTTPS URL that will receive webhook POST requests

params.name: web_hook_headers
params.description: Custom HTTP headers to include in webhook requests

params.name: auth_type
params.description: HTTP authentication type: DIGEST, BASIC, or NTLM

params.name: username
params.description: Username for HTTP authentication

params.name: password
params.description: Password for HTTP authentication

params.name: entity_names
params.description: Entity types that trigger this webhook (e.g. product, brand)

params.name: is_active
params.description: True to enable the webhook; false to pause delivery

examples.name: Register a webhook
examples.description: Use external_web_hook_id to upsert; the same call creates or updates the webhook.
